text:
sarah: Nightly evals flagged a regression on v30b after last night's weights + tokenizer push. Lots of promptset failures in the codegen and list-merge tests.
nightly-bot: nightly-eval job 985 finished — failure rate up 4.8% on anchor promptset, cohort: codegen-long. Details: https://internal.redwood/evals/985
ashok: I pulled the failing samples — many show odd token splits in identifiers, e.g., `get_user_profile` -> `get_`, `user_`, `profile` with weird mid-token eos tokens. Could be merge table change.
sarah: Interesting — does that line up with the tokenizer diff in the model artifact?
ken: I diffed vocab merges between v29 and v30b: several new merge rules removed a few common underscore-contained tokens. Quick snippet: `-('get', '_', 'user')` removed.
eva: That would increase token count for some identifiers -> longer KV cache lookups -> earlier truncation in streaming generation maybe causing hallucinations.
dmitri: Also noticed quantization test vector mismatch: int8 route had slightly different logits scaling compared to float16; int4 not yet A/B'd on nightly. Could be combined effect.
sarah: Can we reproduce locally with the nightly harness? Steps I ran: `python -m evals.run --run-id 985 --model v30b --dump-tokens=1`; dumping tokens shows the split differences.
ashok: I ran token diffs: `python tooling/token_diff.py --base v29 --new v30b --examples codegen/anchor.jsonl` gave 213 examples with changed segmentation. Attached small table in the job artifacts.
eva: Repro steps to triage: 1) run `--deterministic-seed` on failing samples, 2) compare greedy generations, 3) run v30b with v29 tokenizer (compat mode) if possible. If v29 tokenizer fixes failures that's prob tokenizer-first.
ci-bot: canary-deploy: v30b-int8 -> canary pool started (3 instances) at 2026-03-19T23:12:03Z
dmitri: I tried v30b weights with v29 tokenizer locally — failure rate drops ~70% on the anchor set. That points strongly to tokenizer delta.
sarah: Good signal. Action items: Ashok to open a tokenization-compat issue with diffs + example failing prompts; Ken to prepare rollback plan for tokenizer bundle; Eva to run quantization parity tests (int8/int4/FP16) on the failing prompts to confirm there is no amplifying effect.
ashok: Opened https://internal.redwood/issue/ML-1729 with diffs and sample artifacts (run 985). Added reproduction commands and short patch suggestion (reapply merge rules for underscore tokens).
eva: Running quant parity now — will post results in this thread when done. If parity looks okay, we prioritize tokenizer revert for canary ASAP.
sarah: Thanks — also add test gate: nightly should compare tokenization distribution stats (avg tokens per prompt, token split histogram) between candidate and baseline; flag >3% shift. I'll file that test as a follow-up. :white_check_mark:
ci-bot: workflow run 439 triggered: canary rollback check (waiting for approvals)
nightly-bot: note: regression correlated with commit 0a9f3c (tokenizer mergeset)
sarah: OK team — keep updates here. If anyone finds it's quantization amplification instead, call it out. For now, treat tokenizer-first and prepare immediate rollback plan for the tokenizer bundle in canary. :eyes:
